articles.summary: Variety: Movie Ads From Variety's 120 Years: 'Star Wars,' 'Chinatown' and More. The movie business grew up in the pages of Variety. There is no more comprehensive chronicle of film history than Variety – hands down, no contest, case closed. This gallery backs up that bold statement by offering an array of amazing movie and movie-related advertisements drawn from Variety’s 120 years of covering entertainment and Hollywood. …
